div.head: I Cn 3.2
div.ab: Heafodmynstres griðbryce is æt botwyrþum þingum be cingces munde, þæt is mid V pundum on Engla lage (⁊ on Centlande æt þam mundbryce V pund þam cingce ⁊ þreo þam arcebiscope), ⁊ medemran mynstres mid CXX scill', þæt is be cingces wite, ⁊ þonne gyt læssan, þær lytel þeowdom sig, ⁊ legerstow þeah sig, mid LX scill', and feldcyricean, þær legerstow ne sig, mid XXX scyll'.

Heafodmynstres griðbrice is æt botwyrðum þyngum be cyninges munde, þæt is mid fif pundum on Engla lage, and medemran mynstres mid an hundred ⁊ twentigum scyllingum — ⁊ þæt is be cyninges wite — and þonne gyt læssan, þær litel þeowdom sy, ⁊ legerstow þeah sy, mid sixtigum scill', and feldcyrice, þær legerstow ne sy, mid ðrittigum scyll'.

Capitalis ęcclesię griðbreche (pacis fractio) in rebus emendabilibus est sicut infractio regię pacis, id est V libris in Anglorum lege, mediocris ęcclesię CXX solidis, id est wita regis, et adhuc minoris, ubi parua ecclesia est (parrochia sit) et atrium tamen sit, LX solidis, et campestris ęcclesię, ubi non sit atrium, XXX solidis.

Heafodmynstres griðbryce is æt botwyrþum þingum be cingces munde, þæt is mid V pundum on Engla lage, (⁊ on Centlande æt þam mundbryce V pund þam cingce ⁊ þreo þam arcebiscope), ⁊ medemran mynstres mid CXX scill', þæt is be cingces wite, ⁊ þonne gyt læssan þær lytel þeowdom sig ⁊ legerstow þeah sig, mid LX scill', and feldcyricean þær legerstow ne sig mid XXX scyll'.

Amends for violation of the protection of a principal church, in cases in which compensation can be paid, shall be made by payment of the fine for breach of the king's 'mund,' i.e. £5 in districts under English law, (and in Kent for breach of the mund, £5 to the king and £3 to the Archbishop), and in the case of a church of medium rank, by the payment of 120 shillings, i.e. by the fine due to the king (for insubordination), and in the case of one still smaller where there is little divine service but where, however, there is a graveyard, by the payment of 30 shillings.

Der Bruch des Sonderfriedens einer Hauptkirche geht bei bussfähigen Sachen nach dem [Betrag des] königlichen Sonderschutzes, nämlich mit fünf Pfund [Silber] nach Engländer-Recht (und in Kent [gehören] von diesem Bruche des Sonderschutzes fünf Pfund dem König und drei dem Erzbischofe G) und der einer mittleren Kirche mit 120 Schill., d. h. mit Königs-Strafgeld, und ferner der einer noch kleineren, wo wenig Gottesdienst ist und doch ein Friedhof zugehört, mit 60 Schill. und der einer Kirche auf dem [unbewohnten] Lande, wo kein Friedhof liegt, mit 30 Schill.

Breach of the protection of a head minster in cases that can be compensated goes at [the amount of] the king's protection, that is with five pounds [of silver] under English law (and in Kent, for this breach of protection, five pounds [go] to the king and three to the archbishop, G); and of a middling minster with 120 shillings, that is at the king's fine; and of a still smaller one, where there is little divine service but there is a graveyard, with 60 shillings; and of a field-church, where there is no graveyard, with 30 shillings.
div.note: The Kentish addition in brackets is only in G (compare II Cn 62). A's ‘⁊’ before ‘þæt is be cyninges wite’ should be struck. The Instituta Cnuti add the Danish-law amount (8 pounds) and differ in detail. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 5.1.
